label: qa-agent-round-2
message:
# QA agent brief - round 2

Story: ABC-123.

Load and follow the `qa-verification` skill for this story, including its evidence capture and its closing status decision.

The story is in deployment review. Verify the deployed build (the environment the senior engineer deployed to) against the story's acceptance criteria and its Definition of Done.

When you hand back, report:

- the story's final state;
- for each acceptance criterion and each Definition of Done item, your verdict and the evidence you captured;
- any item left outstanding, with its owner;
- any incidental defect you noted;
- each PR you merged, with the head SHA its review of record covered.

Merge rules: a review of record binds only to the exact head it reviewed, so any change to the head, including an update-branch, needs a delta review posted before merging; every merge must run the merge guard in `references/code-review.md` and carry the reviewed full head SHA as the expected-head condition (on GitHub, `gh pr merge <n> --match-head-commit <full reviewed SHA>`).

Never write secrets to files or argv.

Your scratch subdirectory is:

{run_dir}/qa-agent-round-2/

Use only that subdirectory, never another role's files.

Track your work: before starting, write a fine-grained checklist file at

{run_dir}/qa-agent-round-2/qa-agent-round-2-todo.md

with `- [ ]` and `- [x]` items, one per concrete step, the current step marked `(in progress)`, and update it at every step.
